draftPartition: Reuse B.1 evidence_group SHA256 split. Within evidence only, lowest hash modulo five equals zero is reconstruction/complexity audit; remaining four fifths fit. Never train on target drafts, target builds, picks or outcomes.
buildEligibility: Resolved positive integer quantities sum exactly 40; unique modal source build; >=3 observed games; Configurations==1 so supporting mode count is actually known; 12-20 lands and 20-28 nonlands; complete gameplay identity. No outcome selection. Multiple configurations decline because original summaries do not preserve exact mode support.
buildConfidence: HIGH >=5 supporting games and opening-key/modal agreement; MEDIUM all other model-eligible builds; LOW all declines. Opening agreement false does not prove disagreement or completeness.
audit: Audit all available registered non-holdout sets/formats without acquisition; model only eight copy-count-compatible Premier datasets. Ties/non40 configurations from existing qualification aggregates; preserve source provenance.
colorContexts: two largest nonland spell-color loads; splashes separate
selectionOrder: Representation and context jointly minimize calibration-only held-build reconstruction MAE for rank-1 shell profiles, equal-set weight. Candidate family parameters then fit on calibration controlled completion MRR. Development selects best family by primary completion MRR. No post-development tuning.

families.A: Pool-inferred soft color-shell profiles, regularized card inclusion relative to global frequency; no explicit latent clusters
families.B: Nonnegative factorization within shells, ranks 1/2/4, soft deck/pool membership and conditional inclusion residuals
families.C: B plus bounded shrunk pair residual relative to latent expected co-occurrence; no outcome bonus

complexity: Fixed deterministic multiplicative NMF, 100 iterations. Choose smallest rank with >=1% audit reconstruction improvement over rank1, resampled matched-factor cosine >=.8, every effective factor >=25 builds. Otherwise rank1. Rare cards require >=20 fit builds for factor vocabulary; profiles retain all known card marginals.
regularization: Inclusion prior strength50 toward set frequency. Latent marginal shrink50. Pair expected count >=5, both marginals >=20, positive observed >=5; negative expected >=20 and marginals >=30. Confidence expected/(expected+50); effect clip(log((observed+5)/(expected+5)),-1,1). Low-support relationships zero; no rarity bonuses.
poolInference: PoolBeforePick only; candidate never participates in prior belief. Mean weighted log inclusion ratios produce soft membership with prevalence priors. Candidate marginal compatibility includes residual relationships to existing pool. Empty pool returns unchanged A. Pool strength n/(n+8). No D/optimizer/commitment input.
aMapping: Bounded experimental fit .5+.25*tanh(raw compatibility); confidence blend with original A, using evidence-build n/(n+coldPrior) times pool strength. Missing model/card, unsupported shell or empty pool retains original A. Q,L,D,R,commitment,weights,sparse prior and deck projections copied.
primary: Equal-set mean reciprocal rank for one masked nonland build card versus four outcome-independent, absent-from-build distractors with identical colors, mana value within1, frozen Q within.10 and fit-frequency ratio within2. Remove all target copies. >=200 qualified tasks per development set; <=500 lowest-hash tasks/set. Rank ties receive expected rank, TopK fractional credit.
completionControls: Color-only, shell frequency, Q-only, shell-frequency plus Q; all on exactly identical tasks. Unmatched relaxed same-color completion is separately labeled secondary and never passes gate.
secondary: Completion Top1/Top3/normalized rank; audit reconstruction/stability; picked/offered modal-build association; actual human pick agreement; stage/commitment/Q/confidence strata; descriptive outcome uplift only after model fit.

developmentGate.primary: >=2% relative MRR improvement over best color/frequency/Q control
developmentGate.perSet: >=3/5 development sets improve and none lose >5% relative MRR
developmentGate.coverage: >=200 power-matched completion tasks in every development set
developmentGate.confounds: Conditional matched-task gain required; pair low-support effects zero; factors minimum support/stability enforced
developmentGate.coldStart: Missing/empty inputs exactly preserve A; 50-build performance no >5% relative MRR loss to controls; no unbounded pair/card affinities
developmentGate.goldens: All40 unchanged production regressions pass; missing FRA archetype model preserves real cases

learningCurve: 50/100/250/500/1000/2500/full nested lowest-hash evidence builds. Same frozen family/parameters; same independent target completion tasks. Report achieved sizes, reconstruction/factor stability, completion and confidence. No size-specific refit of hyperparameters.
replay: Reuse existing B.1 bulk SQLite, catalog, stats and target sample. Run production once per decision; offline substitute A/B/C only. Target >=50000 complete comparable decisions; primary selection independent of human preferences. Labels joined only after inference.
holdoutRule: Freeze family, all parameters, models and development evidence hashes before final command. If any gate fails, refuse without acquisition or reading MH3/DFT. If full gate passes, do not reuse incompatible replay runner or historical holdout locks; require separately identified D single-use release with proven permitted inputs. Never label missing holdout data a pass.
regressionCases: After development freeze only, export representative actual completion cases for payoff/enabler/generic-vs-fit/off-fit regressions; never tune on these labels
timings: Fit/diagnostic/completion/replay/cold timings, peak process memory, artifact bytes and pool/per-card inference latency
nonGoals: No production implementation, new aggregate provider requests, historical acquisition, manual set archetypes, deep learning, training on wins, next-phase work, or changes to completed C results
